title: Tap & Flow
tagline: Unlock your Flow Wallet with a single tap of your phone - no app needed.
description:
Tap & Flow is an NFC Apple/Google Wallet Pass assigned to your Flow account. We are an infrastructure so that Flow brands can create decentralised loyalty/event passes - without storing their loyalty scheme on central servers. 

The way it works:
- User connects their Flow Wallet
- User signs a message to prove it is them
- Tap & Flow will create a NFC wallet pass which a user can add to their Apple/Google Wallet with 1 click
- Each time the user taps at a supported merchant - they can earn perks - like collectibles, fungible tokens, or even special access to areas.
how_its_made:
Created a disney pinnacles clone for demo as they would be an ideal client
- Login using FCL
- Flow SDK for backend
- Custom NFT Contract in Cadence
- On chain randomness to decide which badge is earned

Website created in Nextjs/Tailwind

Reader was using PAX A920 and the PassEntry demo merchant app.
